methods: Independent source examination of public copy, all 20 guide definitions, guide template, route manifest, prerender and hosting logic; no peer reports read.

Read-only HTTP checks: /, /guides, /guides/student-projects-on-cv, /guides/mba-career-pivot-cv, /for-career-switchers, /job-loop, /pilot, /loop, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /guides/, /blog and an invented 404 route.
Official Google Search Central, Bing Webmaster Tools and OpenAI crawler documentation checked 2026-10-14.
not_tested: Actual indexing, rankings, search impressions, clicks, AI citations and rich-result eligibility; owner console access unavailable.
Authenticated customer flows, traffic/retention/conversion outcomes, browser visual experience and Core Web Vitals.
Complete runtime suite, paid providers or customer data.

criteria.name: Honest and concrete capability claims
criteria.evidence: ProductPage.tsx:38-48,95-112,157-166 separates matching wording from qualifications, fictional demonstrations, optional consent and manual submission.

criteria.name: Audience relevance and message precision
criteria.evidence: job-loop-audiences.ts:5-35 covers student projects, MBA employment pivots and 5-10-year professionals including lateral moves; ProductPage.tsx:149 says MBA applicants.

criteria.name: Crawl, canonical and structured-data foundation
criteria.evidence: Observed initial HTML headings/canonicals; sitemap 38 routes; invented path404; /loop noindex; scripts/build-host-worker.mjs:104-131 and prerender manifest.

criteria.name: Content usefulness and connected journeys
criteria.evidence: CareerGuides.tsx:64-83 has structured takeaways, explicit sources and related guides; AudienceLanding.tsx:17-23 lacks task-guide links; end CTA generic.

criteria.name: Organic measurement and learning
criteria.evidence: 20261012181402_jobvance_admin_snapshot.sql:77-78 marks guest visits/checks and browser download completion untracked; no owner search-console evidence.

strengths: Public copy explains the free accountless CV-to-vacancy task concretely and avoids fabricated outcomes, testimonials or qualification guarantees.
Distinct persona examples preserve academic context, personal contribution, projected versus measured results and employer confidentiality.
Manifest-driven prerender provides real public HTML, canonicals, sitemap, structured data, private noindex and genuine404 behavior.
20 guides have substantive task advice, fictional examples, sources, takeaways, related links and transparent AI-assistance disclosure.

findings.problem: The no-account organic journey is not measured; registered-account milestones cannot establish guide-to-approved-download performance.

evidence.detail: Guest visits/checks and download completion are explicitly untracked.
Generic /check and /loop links carry no content-origin identifier.
Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and crawler/attribution reports were not available.

findings.recommendation: Create an owner-reviewed weekly route report combining Google/Bing search metrics and a minimal privacy-reviewed first-party journey count. Exclude CV/vacancy content and freeform queries. Label download actions separately from delivery completion.
acceptance_criteria: Dated baseline lists 38 public URLs, known indexed status where available, impressions/clicks and explicit unknowns.
One QA journey contributes once to guide-to-check, review-reached and approved-download-action stages; synthetic traffic excluded from customer metrics.
Named owner and privacy/data-retention decision; no raw candidate content captured.
dependencies: Owner access to verified search properties
findings.cost_effect: Use existing/free reporting first; no required paid service. Engineering and ongoing review time only.

findings.problem: Audience pages do not link to task-relevant guides, while guide actions discard audience context and send informational saving traffic to the private workspace.

evidence.detail: Audience journey contains check, Job Loop and sign-in actions but no task-specific guide links.

findings.recommendation: Add two relevant guides on each audience page, preserve explicit audience in check links, and point explanatory saving CTA to /job-loop.
acceptance_criteria: Each persona can reach its useful guide and accountless check with explicit stage preserved.
Explore saving leads to public explanation without unexpected sign-in.
Links are real anchors in initial public HTML.

findings.problem: The library provides prose but lacks a shared reusable evidence artifact; older repository growth plans describe obsolete dates and automation/outreach positioning.

evidence.detail: Guide sections support paragraphs, bullets and fictional examples; no shared task worksheet representation.
Legacy map describes automation/AI academy/outreach-oriented content.
Calendar begins in2024 and proposes older content priorities.
A worked shared artifact could improve usefulness; this requires pilot observation, not a promised search gain.

findings.recommendation: Improve cv-job-description-evidence, student-projects-on-cv, mba-career-pivot-cv and reuse-second-application around one requirement/source/contribution/result/uncertainty/approved-wording/next-action worksheet. Add lateral-move evidence and replace the obsolete editorial plan.
acceptance_criteria: One copyable worksheet and four completed fictional examples with current citations.
Student academic, MBA pivot and professional lateral-move variants preserve contribution/result boundaries.
Pilot readers can use the worksheet on one vacancy; record task usefulness and confusion without hiring/ranking claims.
Old keyword/calendar plan is marked superseded and replaced by a prioritized existing-URL map.
findings.cost_effect: No model/search spend required; editorial time is the principal cost.

findings.problem: Hardcoded global dates prevent accurate per-guide revision tracking after the next independent content update.

evidence.detail: publish() assigns every guide publishedAt2026-10-13 and updatedAt2026-10-14.
Live MBA guide publishes these dates in BlogPosting JSON-LD.

findings.recommendation: Store dates per guide and retain an internal reviewer/source-check record and next-review trigger, particularly for official UAE guidance and changing product capabilities. Keep honest organization authorship.
acceptance_criteria: A single guide edit changes only its dateModified and sitemap lastmod.
Each volatile source has a named maintenance owner and documented check; no invented expert credentials.
findings.cost_effect: No new vendor cost; small recurring editorial review effort.

findings.problem: For MBA applicants can imply admissions preparation although the destination supports employment during or after an MBA.

evidence.detail: Home audience link says For MBA applicants.
Admissions confusion is plausible but has not been observed in user research.

findings.recommendation: Use For MBA students and alumni consistently and keep examples/metadata focused on employment.
acceptance_criteria: Three pilot readers correctly identify the supported employment task without explanation.
Navigation and landing-page terminology agree; no admissions promise.

open_questions: Who owns and can access verified Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools properties?
Which guide entries actually generate search impressions or help pilot users complete a truthful application?
Who will own editorial source rechecks and the replacement of the2024 content calendar?
do_not_build_now: Twenty additional generic blogs or cloned persona workflows.
Keyword-stuffed ATS pages, fake experts/testimonials or promised hiring/search results.
Paid SEO tools, custom AI visibility percentages or special AI markup/files justified as ranking requirements.
